Run a spatial command

Source: R/spatial.R
tda_sd.Rd

tda_sd reaches any of TDA's spatial commands; the named functions are the ones with an obvious meaning. The spatial data is opened with sdnvar first, which is what the commands operate on.

Usage

tda_sd(s, cmd, options = list(), rhs = NULL, setup = character(), ...)

Arguments

s

a tda_spatial.

cmd

the command name, e.g. "sdinf", "sdvd".

options

a named list of options for the command.

rhs

the command's right-hand side, when it takes one.

setup

extra commands to run before it, such as a PostScript setup.

...

passed to tda_run.

Value

An object carrying the run and, where the command writes one, a table.

See also

Other spatial analysis: plot.tda_spatial(), tda_map(), tda_polygons(), tda_read_dbf(), tda_read_shapefile(), tda_read_spatial, tda_sd_analyses, tda_sd_ps3(), tda_spatial()

Examples

d <- data.frame(id = 1:4, x = c(0, 1, 1, 0), y = c(0, 0, 1, 1))
s <- tda_spatial(d)
r <- tda_sd(s, "sdinf")
cat(r$run$output, sep = "\n")
